passportTab.subtitle: Requisites by edition
passportTab.effectiveDateHelp: The date from which the edition becomes effective; until then the document is in the "Awaiting entry into force" status.
passportTab.changesClue: These dates are set automatically: "Requisites changed" — when the document's requisites are saved, "Edition changed" — when this edition's file is replaced (for legacy documents migrated without a single edit — the adoption date of this edition). They cannot be changed manually.
passportTab.actualizationClue: The full history of all document actualizations can be viewed in the VND actualization log, once the first edition is added.

actualizationTab.performStepHintNeedsPerform: Before working with editions, specify whether the next actualization due date should be shifted and whether the actualization will be without document changes — the "Perform actualization" button is on the Editions tab.
actualizationTab.performStepHintWaiting: The person responsible for actualization has not completed this step yet — uploading a new edition is unavailable until then.
actualizationTab.noChangesHintWithApproval: It has been declared that the actualization will proceed without document changes — a new edition will not be required. Submit the current effective edition for approval on the Approval tab as is, without uploading a new file. A new edition will appear only if the approvers request revisions.

coordinationTab.finalHoldPendingHint: Final hold is a review stage. Leaving a decision on it is optional: if you have no comments, you may do nothing and the document will move on by itself.
